summary: An eight-voice analog-style polysynth in the spirit of early-1980s American poly synths, played on four tracks with a mixer, send effects and a step sequencer.
features: Two oscillators a voice with hard sync and cross-modulation
Filter modes include a four-pole ladder and an SEM-style morph
Four tracks of up to 256 steps with polymeter, ratchets and chance
Tracks start on the bar; 8 patterns keep their own sounds and mix
99 program slots with 70 factory sounds; arpeggiator follows MIDI clock
USB MIDI in and out, TRS MIDI in, a MIDI channel per track
